The form preserves its original source-access and amendment-review limits. No new current-law review is claimed by this implementation.
Additional service, recording and amount conditions described below remain mandatory; this calculator is not a notice-sending or lien-filing service.
Residential: demand arbitration within ten days after actual NUB lodging and comply with service. Serve the lien within ten days after actual lodging on every required owner/contractor/subcontractor.

The form VERIFIED addendum supersedes its earlier unresolved-source summary. A889 was pending on October 11 and must be rechecked before release. July 3 closure and holiday-extension rules remain unverified; never extend forward.

NUB service and arbitration-demand service remain distinct mandatory acts. Named task completion records customer-reported completion only; it does not establish legally sufficient service, the NUB lodging date or an award. Identify known late/defective service or procedural/award exceptions for qualified review; never assume a120-day extension.

preliminary_notice.name: Residential NUB and arbitration notices
preliminary_notice.description: After actual NUB lodging, separately serve the NUB under section7 and the arbitration demand under section21 within10calendar days. These actual-event clocks remain independent of final furnishing. Timely original NUB lodging and applicable service/procedure qualifications remain separate lien prerequisites; these dates do not certify entitlement.

notice_duties.name: Serve notice of unpaid balance (NUB)
notice_duties.description: Serve the NUB copy on every required recipient by the applicable statutory method. This service act is distinct from county lodging and the arbitration demand. Late-service consequences retain the material-prejudice qualification and require review.

notice_duties.name: Serve arbitration demand
notice_duties.description: Serve the required arbitration demand within10 calendar days after this NUB was actually lodged, on the ordinary statutory arbitration path. A written alternativeADR or identified procedural exception retains review; this date does not predict an award.

lien_filing.name: Lodge residential lien claim
lien_filing.description: One lien lodging act is constrained by both actual determination receipt+10 and last qualifying furnishing+120; the earlier cap controls. Timely NUB lodging and applicable service/arbitration conditions remain prerequisites. A task receipt does not certify them or extend either cap.

preliminary_notice.name: Residential NUB and arbitration notices

notice_duties.name: Serve notice of unpaid balance (NUB)
notice_duties.description: Serve the NUB copy on every required recipient by the applicable statutory method. This service act is distinct from county lodging and the arbitration demand. Late-service consequences retain the material-prejudice qualification and require review.

notice_duties.name: Serve arbitration demand
notice_duties.description: Serve the required arbitration demand within10 calendar days after this NUB was actually lodged, on the ordinary statutory arbitration path. A written alternativeADR or identified procedural exception retains review; this date does not predict an award.

lien_filing.name: Lodge residential lien claim
lien_filing.description: One lien lodging act is constrained by both actual determination receipt+10 and last qualifying furnishing+120; the earlier cap controls. Timely NUB lodging and applicable service/arbitration conditions remain prerequisites. A task receipt does not certify them or extend either cap.

warnings: Draft implementation of the bound #327 form; exact implementation approval and canonical promotion are required before release.
The form preserves its original source-access and amendment-review limits. No new current-law review is claimed by this implementation.
Additional service, recording and amount conditions described below remain mandatory; this calculator is not a notice-sending or lien-filing service.
Residential: demand arbitration within ten days after actual NUB lodging and comply with service. Serve the lien within ten days after actual lodging on every required owner/contractor/subcontractor.

The form VERIFIED addendum supersedes its earlier unresolved-source summary. A889 was pending on October 11 and must be rechecked before release. July 3 closure and holiday-extension rules remain unverified; never extend forward.

NUB service and arbitration-demand service remain distinct mandatory acts. Named task completion records customer-reported completion only; it does not establish legally sufficient service, the NUB lodging date or an award. Identify known late/defective service or procedural/award exceptions for qualified review; never assume a120-day extension.

preliminary_notice.name: Residential NUB and arbitration notices
preliminary_notice.description: After actual NUB lodging, separately serve the NUB under section7 and the arbitration demand under section21 within10calendar days. These actual-event clocks remain independent of final furnishing. Timely original NUB lodging and applicable service/procedure qualifications remain separate lien prerequisites; these dates do not certify entitlement.

notice_duties.name: Serve notice of unpaid balance (NUB)
notice_duties.description: Serve the NUB copy on every required recipient by the applicable statutory method. This service act is distinct from county lodging and the arbitration demand. Late-service consequences retain the material-prejudice qualification and require review.

notice_duties.name: Serve arbitration demand
notice_duties.description: Serve the required arbitration demand within10 calendar days after this NUB was actually lodged, on the ordinary statutory arbitration path. A written alternativeADR or identified procedural exception retains review; this date does not predict an award.

lien_filing.name: Lodge residential lien claim
lien_filing.description: One lien lodging act is constrained by both actual determination receipt+10 and last qualifying furnishing+120; the earlier cap controls. Timely NUB lodging and applicable service/arbitration conditions remain prerequisites. A task receipt does not certify them or extend either cap.
